OAuthRedirects.description: Browser redirects of the OAuth callback

failure.description: Where a failed login or callback lands, with `?reason=<CODE>` (required)

success.description: Where a successful login lands when the login did not carry an allowed `redirect` parameter

Record<string, any>.description: Construct a type with a set of properties K of type T

access_type.description: Type of access: "offline" also returns a refresh token (stored encrypted in the ident tokens)

allowedEmailDomains.description: Only these email domains may use this provider (see ProviderEmailPolicy)

audiences.description: Other client ids whose ID tokens `Auth.Google.Token` accepts (for example Android/iOS client ids)

auth_options.description:
Additional authorization url parameters (for example `prompt`, `login_hint`); cannot override `state`,
`redirect_uri`, `scope`, `access_type`, `response_type`, `code_challenge*`, `nonce` nor `hd`
See https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/openid-connect#authenticationuriparameters

authorized_uris.description:
Allowed post-login targets for the `redirect` query parameter of the login route: absolute http(s) urls, a
target matches when it has the same origin and its path is the listed path or below it

hostedDomain.description:
Only accept Google Workspace accounts of this domain (the `hd` claim of the ID token); also sent as a hint to
the account chooser

redirect_uri.default: "<absolute url of the request>/callback"; set it explicitly behind a proxy
redirect_uri.description: Callback url registered at the provider

trustEmailVerification.description: Whether the verification of the email is believed (see ProviderEmailPolicy)

url.description: Route prefix of the login (`<url>`) and callback (`<url>/callback`) routes

challenge.description:
Will be computed by the service

hash of the content prefixed by 'WEBDA'

hash.description:
Will be computed by the service

hash of the content

metadata.description: Metadatas stored along with the binary

OAuthTokens.description:
Credentials as returned by an OAuth token endpoint (google-auth-library `Credentials` shape): `id_token`,
`access_token`, `refresh_token`, `expiry_date`, `token_type`, `scope`... Values are not typed by the schema
(providers send nulls); providers check what they use.

Webda/OAuthTokenRequest.description: Input of the `Auth.<Provider>.Token` operations: `token`, or the provider credentials `tokens`

token.description: Token issued by the provider to the client (an ID token for OpenID Connect providers)

tokens.description: Credentials obtained by the client from the provider (v3 body; its `id_token` is verified)

Webda/OAuthTokenRequest.title: OAuthTokenRequest
